1: Compute the limit as x approaches 1 of (x^3-1)/((x-1)(x+2)). A. -1  B. 0  C. 1/3  D. 1
2: Vectors u=[4,-5] and v=[-1,-5] are given. Compute the length of the vector u - 4v. A. 7  B. 15  C. 17  D. 23
3: Points A, B, C, D, E lie on a circle with center S. The measure of angle BCD is 110 degrees, and the measure of angle BDA is 35 degrees (see figure). Find the measure of angle DEA. A. 100  B. 105  C. 110  D. 115
4: From the set of thirteen numbers {1,2,...,13}, two numbers are drawn simultaneously. Compute the number of different ways to draw two numbers from this set whose product is even.
5: The polynomial W(x) = 7x^3 - 9x^2 + 9x - 2 has exactly one real root. Compute this root. (In the original exam, students enter the first three digits after the decimal point of its decimal expansion into answer boxes.)
8: A container holds seven balls: five white and two black. Two balls are drawn simultaneously without replacement; then one more ball is drawn from those remaining. Compute the probability of drawing a black ball on this second draw.
9: A function f is given by f(x) = (3x^2-2x)/(x^2+2x+8) for every real x. The point P=(x0,3) lies on the graph of f. Compute x0, and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of f at point P.
12: Solve the equation 3*sin^2(x) - sin^2(2x) = 0 in the interval [pi, 2*pi].
13: A quadrilateral ABCD with |BC|=4 and |CD|=5 is circumscribed about a circle (tangential quadrilateral). Diagonal AC makes a 60-degree angle with side BC, and forms an acute angle with side AB whose sine equals 1/4. Compute the perimeter of quadrilateral ABCD.
14: A cube ABCDEFGH has edge length 6. Point S is the intersection of diagonals AH and DE of the lateral face ADHE (see figure). Compute the height of triangle SBH drawn from vertex S to side BH.
16: Consider triangles ABC where A=(0,0), B=(m,0) for m in (4,+infinity), and vertex C lies on the line y=-2x. Point D=(3,2) lies on side BC. a) Show that the area P of triangle ABC, as a function of m, is given by P(m)=m^2/(m-4). b) Find the value of m for which the area P is smallest, and find the equation of line BC for that value of m.
